info.title: vvivid.dev public content API
info.description: Anonymous read-only metadata for published articles, project notes, and pages. Generated by Hugo at build time; full text is available at each item's markdown_url.

get.description: Returns one complete snapshot, with no pagination, query filtering, or server-side search. Filter items locally by section, title, description, or tags. Unknown query parameters are ignored.

200.description: Published content, ordered by Hugo's content date descending; undated pages follow dated pages.

head.summary: Read content snapshot response headers without its body

200.description: The same headers as GET, with an empty body.

count.description: Number of items in this snapshot.

description.description: Authored description, falling back to a plain-text summary.

markdown_url.description: Direct Markdown representation of the page.

section.description: Hugo section, such as posts or projects; empty for a top-level page.

published_at.description: Hugo's resolved publication date; omitted when unknown.

modified_at.description: Hugo's resolved last modification date, which defaults to the content date; omitted when unknown.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The static origin only supports GET and HEAD for content. Other methods are not write operations.

HTTPError.description: An HTTP serving error. Unknown resource paths return 404. Error bodies are HTML, not a JSON API envelope.
